scripts.lint:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff check . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check .
scripts.test:api: uv --directory apps/api run --extra dev pytest tests/ -v
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm openapi:export && pnpm --dir apps/web run api:generate
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json apps/web/src/lib/api-client/schema.d.ts
scripts.dev:api: bash -c 'set -a && . ./scripts/ports.sh && set +a && pnpm sync:api && uv --directory apps/api run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$API_PORT"'
